name: optcatalog_set_pending_spawn_target_overrides
description: OptCatalog::SetPendingSpawnTargetOverrides stores the pending target count/list override pointers.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent OptCatalog/zWeapon source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4ae4a0 validates storing ECX to g_OptCatalogPendingSpawnTargetCountPtr and EDX to g_OptCatalogPendingSpawnTargetListPtr, then returning.
The native smoke verifies both non-null override storage and reset-to-null behavior through the public helper.
